digest.component_or_area: plan-review gate / model ladder start-rung location
propositions: models_at_or_above() falls through to the entire MODEL_LADDER fallback for any non-Anthropic-family primary, because substring-matching against Anthropic names fails; the caller receives the whole ladder starting from the smallest rung instead of the primary's own rung
Pass-1 escalation assigns the returned lowest rung (e.g. claude-haiku-4-5) to the run config, downgrading context window and crossing to a different provider family from what the operator configured

largest_window_tokens() returns the MODEL_LADDER maximum (1000000) for an unlocated primary instead of an honest conservative bound, causing P8 under-blocking and silent truncation of material that should fail with _too_big
prerequisites.py escalation path has the same defect via ladder[0] indexing on an unlocated primary, jumping to claude-haiku instead of staying on the operator's model

The fix must return [model] for truthy-but-unlocated primaries in models_at_or_above() to preserve the one-criterion retry, and return the ladder minimum for the same case in largest_window_tokens() to be conservative
Three pinned assertions in test_model_class_ladder.py encode the current defective behaviour and must be inverted to the new explicit-outcome contract
